title: 第3章 陆青青的后悔第4章 复仇开始
content_zh:
吼！
几分钟后，一阵低沉的龙吟响彻开来，林炎体内，原本干瘪的武脉，居然重新觉醒。
养气境，修炼的就是武脉。
人体一共有九条武脉，分别对应着养气九重。
每开辟一条武脉，养气境修为就增加一重。
等九条武脉开辟之后，就是气海境！
气海境，则是吸收外部力量扩充气海，每提升一个境界，气海扩充一倍。
直至最后，气海达到一个极限，这时候体内真气转化为灵气，便是灵海境。
轰！
这次，林炎一共有四条武脉被开辟出。
并且林炎发现，他的武脉居然是金色的！武脉之中蕴含着磅礴的力量！
“圣龙，我这武脉怎么不对劲？”林炎好奇。
“九龙吞天诀修炼出的武脉，是圣龙武脉，不仅真气更凝练，而且爆发力更强！能够越级而战！”
圣龙解释道，只是那声音却有些虚弱。
原本庞大的金色圣体，也都暗淡了几分。
“圣龙，你怎么回事？”林炎惊讶。
“我的境界太高，苏醒对我来说是一种很大的损耗，我必须得沉睡一段时间，才能保住修为之力。”
“接下来一段时间，我得沉睡一会了，除非你遇到化解不了的麻烦，不然的话不要轻易唤醒我。”圣龙尊者虚弱道。
“那我要如何才能帮你恢复？”林炎是一个知恩图报的人，圣龙帮了他，他自然不可能坐视不理对方的虚弱。
“等你突破到生死境再说这件事，现在还差得远，你先保住自己，再说反哺的事情。”

话音落下，那金色圣龙便暗淡下来，就好像是一具石像一般，再没丝毫气机。
“我一定会突破到生死境的！”
林炎暗暗发誓，捏紧了拳头。
忽然的，他察觉到有脚步声靠近而来。
林炎散开神念一扫，便察觉到陆青青正在跟一个神态凶恶的老太婆一同返回。
“小姐，你可真是太粗心大意了，既然已经撕破脸皮，就不能留下他，不然的话始终是个祸害。”
那老太婆的眼神散发着寒芒，怨毒道。
“是陆慧那个老东西。”
林炎眼神一冷，陆慧正是陆青青的奶娘，当初林炎与陆青青订婚之后，陆慧以方便照顾陆青青为由，也搬来了林家。
“慧姨，三长老已经废掉了林炎的修为，他应该不会有太大的危险吧？而且他马上就要被发配到林家灵矿去了。”陆青青蹙着眉。
“话是这么说，可那小畜生常年在外打拼，说不定就认识某些人脉，如果让他活着离开，指不定会对咱们构成威胁。咱们不比林龙少爷，他有林家当靠山，咱们俩却需要万事小心。”
“况且，万一那小畜生嘴巴贱，将你和龙少的事传出去，到时候岂不是影响了你们俩的名誉？小姐你也不想让自己的名誉被玷污吧？”
陆慧森然道。
“哈哈哈，一对奸夫淫妇，居然还配谈名誉？可笑！”
这时房间内传来了一阵讥讽与冷笑，而后林炎从房间内走出。
看到这一幕，陆青青和陆慧都傻眼了：
“小畜生，你这么快就恢复了？”
她可是听小姐说，三长老废掉了林炎，而且重创了对方，按理说最起码得在床上躺十天半个月。
可现在的林炎，身体气血旺盛，哪里像是奄奄一息的模样？
“就算恢复了又怎样？反正已经是一个废物了，难不成还能逃出咱们得手掌心？”

陆青青冷笑。
“陆青青！我自订婚三年来，自问没有对不起你的地方，你不仅背叛我，还想置我于死地，你未免太狠毒了吧！”
content_en:
roar!
A few minutes later, a low dragon roar resounded, and the originally withered martial veins in Lin Yan's body reawakened.
In the Qi-nourishing realm, martial arteries are cultivated.
There are nine martial arteries in the human body, each corresponding to the ninth level of Qi nourishment.
Every time a martial vein is opened, the cultivation level of Qi Nourishing Realm increases by one level.
After the nine martial veins are opened, it will be the Qi Sea realm!
The Qi Sea realm absorbs external power to expand the Qi Sea. Every time you advance to a higher level, the Qi Sea doubles in size.
Until finally, the sea of ​​​​qi reaches a limit. At this time, the true qi in the body is transformed into spiritual energy, which is the realm of spiritual sea.
boom!
This time, Lin Yan had a total of four martial veins opened up.
And Lin Yan discovered that his martial arts veins were actually golden! The martial arteries contain majestic power!
"Holy Dragon, what's wrong with my martial arts?" Lin Yan was curious.
"The martial veins cultivated by the Nine Dragons Swallowing Heaven Technique are the holy dragon martial arts. Not only is the true energy more condensed, but it is also more explosive! It can fight across levels!"
Shenglong explained, but his voice was a little weak.
The originally huge golden holy body also dimmed a bit.
"Shenglong, what's wrong with you?" Lin Yan was surprised.
"My realm is too high. Waking up is a huge loss for me. I have to sleep for a period of time in order to maintain the power of cultivation."
"In the next period of time, I have to sleep for a while. Unless you encounter trouble that cannot be resolved, don't wake me up easily." Lord Shenglong said weakly.
"Then how can I help you recover?" Lin Yan is a man who repays his kindness. Shenglong helped him, so he naturally could not just sit back and ignore the other party's weakness.
"We won't talk about this until you break through to the realm of life and death. It's still far away now. You should protect yourself first, and then talk about repaying the debt."
As soon as the words fell, the golden holy dragon dimmed, as if it were a stone statue, without any vitality at all.
"I will definitely break through to the realm of life and death!"
Lin Yan swore secretly and clenched his fists.
Suddenly, he noticed footsteps approaching.
Lin Yan dispersed his thoughts and noticed that Lu Qingqing was returning with a ferocious old woman.
"Miss, you are so careless. Now that you have broken your skin, you cannot keep him, otherwise he will always be a disaster."
The old woman's eyes exuded a cold light and she said bitterly.
"It's that old guy Lu Hui."
Lin Yan's eyes turned cold. Lu Hui was Lu Qingqing's nanny. After Lin Yan and Lu Qingqing got engaged, Lu Hui also moved to the Lin family on the grounds that it was convenient to take care of Lu Qingqing.
"Aunt Hui, the third elder has destroyed Lin Yan's cultivation. He shouldn't be in much danger, right? And he will be sent to the Lin Jialing Mine soon." Lu Qingqing frowned.
"That's what I said, but that little beast has been working hard outside all year round, and he may know some people. If he is allowed to leave alive, he may pose a threat to us. We are no better than Master Lin Long. He has the Lin family as his backer, but we two need to be careful in everything."
"Besides, if that little beast talks badly and spreads the news about you and Mr. Long, won't it affect both of your reputations? Miss, you don't want your reputation to be tarnished, right?"
Lu Huisen said calmly.
"Hahaha, a couple of adulterers and adulterers actually deserve to talk about reputation? Ridiculous!"
At this time, there was a burst of sarcasm and sneer in the room, and then Lin Yan walked out of the room.
Seeing this scene, Lu Qingqing and Lu Hui were both dumbfounded:
"Little beast, you recovered so quickly?"
But she heard from the young lady that the third elder had destroyed Lin Yan and severely injured him. Logically speaking, he would have to stay in bed for at least ten days and a half.
But now Lin Yan's body is full of vitality and blood, but he doesn't look like he's dying?
"So what if you recover? You are already a waste anyway, is it possible that you can still escape from our grasp?"
Lu Qingqing sneered.
"Lu Qingqing! I have been engaged for three years.I have nothing to say to you. Not only did you betray me, you also wanted to kill me. You are too cruel! "
